title: KithCore
description: A social-first multiplayer RPG engine for evolving shared worlds. Build on an authoritative server, a customizable browser client and validated live content updates. Meadow Sample is the included, editable game world.

features.title: Authoritative multiplayer
features.text: Server-owned movement, combat, inventory and quest state. The browser client adds prediction, interpolation, targeting and casting feedback.

features.title: Social systems first
features.text: NPC gestures and speech, ambient interactions, parties, friends, reputation, public chat, whispers and offline mail with item attachments.

features.title: Combat, quests and objects
features.text: Data-defined class roles, personal recovery, friendly healing, party recovery and ally shields. Server-owned loot, equipment and bags, quest progress, gathering, readable books, vendors, banking and interactive objects.

features.title: A client you can make yours
features.text: Character creation, race/class support, maps, windows and settings. Customize the theme and UI behavior or provide a different client entry point.

features.title: World content stays separate
features.text: Meadow is a small editable example package. Replace its races, classes, scenery and story; larger games can be distributed independently.

features.title: Deploy and evolve
features.text: Linux-first Node/Docker setup, separate saves, backups and validated additive live content updates. Current alpha: one simulation/store writer per world.

features.title: Build visuals from source
features.text: Procedural scenery, characters and equipment stay editable. Worlds can supply distinct gear silhouettes and themed palettes; generated art, demo films and website builds stay outside source control.

scenes.title: A place to begin
scenes.description: Meadow camp: quests, supplies, storage and a postbox, with the shared RPG systems behind them.

scenes.title: A compact world with height
scenes.description: Sunrise Ridge: an elevated rest stop and nearby practice cairns, connected by walkable hillside trails.

scenes.title: A second place to call home
scenes.description: Willow rest: a wooded quest hub, herb clearing and breadcrumb toward Ridgewatch.
